creativeThesis: Deliberately undesigned. This fixture exists to prove routing, content resolution and metadata in isolation, so that a later creative failure cannot be mistaken for a routing failure.
antiTargets: Anything that could be mistaken for the reference-class proof

typography.intent: System fonts only, so no typographic decision is implied.
principles: Do not set a display face.

composition.intent: One column, source order, no art direction.
principles: Every route uses the same plain structure.
Difference between routes must come from data, not styling.

imagery.intent: Prove that arbitrary client media resolves and that focal points reach CSS.

motion.reducedMotionIntent: Nothing to reduce: the fixture has no motion in any mode.

responsive.intent: Reflow only. This fixture is explicitly not art-directed for mobile.
principles: Do not treat this as evidence of responsive art direction.

signatureIntent.name: None
signatureIntent.purpose: The neutral fixture declares no Signature; a Signature belongs to the reference-class proof.
